comments.mergedPostDetails:
# Concept

After joining a group instance of any type (regular, +, or public) a user could be presented with a welcome screen/window/modal of some sort which they have to accept/close, featuring group provided information.

# Motivation

When joining a group instance, especially a public or "+" one a user might not fully understand the group or a community behind it, its purpose, rules, culture etc. or just the specific event in general. And they might be too lazy to research the group.

# Examples

User joins a party world group instance:

> Welcome screen pops up describing the event, who's the moderator, rules forbidding certain behaviors or poorly optimized avatars.

User joins a theater world group instance:

> Welcome screen pops up with the description of what movies are they watching tonight and to avoid lengthy conversations.

# Details

This could be in a form of a window with text and a button to close it, maybe "Accept" it. It could pop up right after joining the instance. It could feature group's description and/or its rules and/or an instance-specific description. It could pop up only once ever per each group, or it could pop up every time with a checkbox to don't show it again. Or it could pop up once each instance. Or if the information has changed.

comments.value:
As a side thought, I wonder if presenting a user with a dialog window that says "click ok to get kicked from this instance" would violate the TOS. 

People got used to ignoring pop-ups. 

I do think it's a good idea though.

author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

comments.value: Lacking the ability to present the rules upfront is making group public instance moderation unnecessarily more difficult and unpleasant. I hope this feature is included soon.

comments.mergedPostDetails: For those who join Group Public, or Group+ instances, non-members who join the instance should be shown the list of group rules before proceeding to explore that instance.
comments.mergedPostTitle: Non-members should receive a list of Group rules when joining a Group instance

Merge with this for more upvote power!
100 up votes! I think this needs more!

Might have been discussed already but I feel this should pop up when the user clicks the Join button on the instance so they dont have to sit through a whole loading screen to be welcomed to a group they don't want to be with.

This is still a very much needed feature. Group public instances are nice and all, but a lot of new users don't know what the difference is between those and normal public instances.

This would go a long way to make it more obvious to players that it is an instance managed by a group and that it might have other rules.

There are multiple existing frameworks that have been added to VRChat that could be hooked into for this feature, such as:

- Go button for prompting entry after a world is loaded.

- Furality consent warning for third-party data processing before entry after a world is loaded.

- Performance gating pop-up before even loading the world.

details:
Confirmed with bags that this is not a thing yet.

Would be neat if you could set a welcome message for a group instance. This way users know that this is a group instance. And they know it potentially has elevated moderation.

Or can be used to advertise the group in general.
